one_line_description: Cloud-based messaging app with focus on security and speed
auth_methods_evidence: Each bot is given a unique authentication token when it is created. The token looks something like `123456:ABC-DEF1234ghIkl-zyx57W2v1u123ew11`
self_serve_evidence: You can learn about obtaining tokens and generating new ones in this document
buildability_rationale: Self-serve API key authentication, comprehensive documentation, broad API surface with webhook support, and Composio integration
agent_notes: The Telegram Bot API provides a well-documented, self-service authentication system using API tokens. The API supports both REST and webhook patterns, with extensive functionality for building bots.
